title: Split Geometry Play Dev Wiring
description: Create geometry wasm bindings surface for Topologic, add R3F React components for Topology/Vertex/Edge/Wire/Face/Shell/Cell/CellComplex/Cluster, add comprehensive topology fixture JSON using all kinds, and add geometry playground with same UI shell pattern and transform gumball selection for each kind.
summary: Added a new @elements/geometry package with a Topologic browser binding facade in geometry/wasm, fixture-driven R3F components for all Topologic core kinds in geometry/react, a comprehensive all-kinds topology fixture, and a UI-based geometry play app with kind/entity selection plus transform gumball editing. Validated with geometry package build and Vitest.
